svg.data-weight-note: 19.4 lb (8.8 kg) with one power supply (Table 6)
svg.data-rj45-speeds: 10 GbE, 1 GbE or 100 Mbps on each fixed port
svg.data-expansion-ports: up to 48 ports with two 8-port modules, or 2 x 40 GbE with a QSFP+ module
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 120 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 7.8 A and 3.8 A
svg.data-power-input-dc: operating range -36 to -72 VDC, nominal -48 VDC, 7 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load sharing; do not mix AC and DC, or AFI and AFO
svg.data-fans: three fan modules and a fan in each supply; the switch runs 30 seconds while one fan module is replaced
svg.data-heat-btu-h: 1375 BTU an hour at the maximum system power (Table 22)
svg.data-altitude: no loss of performance to 10,000 ft (3,048 m)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches, mixed with EX4200 and EX4500; a 10GBASE-T port joins only EX4550 switches
svg.data-expansion: two module slots (front and rear), EX4550-EM-8XSFP, EX4550-EM-8XT, EX4550-EM-2QSFP and EX4550-VC-128G
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
svg.data-console: mini-USB console port (active) and RJ-45 console port (passive)

g.data-description: Table 11 - red: major alarm; yellow: minor alarm; unlit: no alarm or the switch is halted
g.title: led-alm

g.data-description: Table 11 - green steady: Junos OS loaded; green blinking: the switch is booting; unlit: off or halted
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: Table 11 - standalone: green steady when working; Virtual Chassis: green steady primary, blinking backup, unlit line card
g.title: led-mst

g.data-description: Tables 12 and 13 - the link and activity lamp is green steady with a link and blinking with traffic; the status lamp blinks once a second at 10 Mbps, twice at 100 Mbps and three times at 1000 Mbps
g.title: mgmt
